# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment fact documents generated for this report.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - Application and component-level architecture diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - External dependency map grouped by functional categories.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - HTTP/page-handler contracts and service communication patterns.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, entity relationships, and data ownership boundaries.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, runtime profiles, and sensitive settings inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core business workflows, rules, and end-to-end process sequence.
